job.title: Solution Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris

tailoring.headline: Solution Architect & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, RESTful APIs, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Experienced in techno-functional requirements analysis, solution design and stakeholder management.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Solution Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of hands-on expertise engineering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud and Hybris architectures for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical proficiency and strong techno-functional solution design capabilities. I am eager to contribute my expertise to A2G Consulting BV in delivering robust e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented complex backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 using Java and Spring, following platform best practices, design patterns, and enterprise standards.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and engineered high-performance PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub across international projects.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analyzing integration bottlenecks, authoring functional specifications, and translating stakeholder needs into robust SAP solutions.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring to reduce latency, and managed core modules including Promotions Engine, OMS, and FlexibleSearch.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your architectural goals.

tailoring.why_company: A2G Consulting BV stands out for its specialized focus on delivering advanced SAP Commerce solutions for enterprise clients. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of hands-on architectural and development experience with SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell to support your client projects, streamline complex integrations, and drive high-impact digital transformations.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell to design robust enterprise architectures, seamless integrations, and scalable e-commerce solutions for A2G Consulting BV.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, with 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, OCC REST API, and integration skills to your solution architect role. I am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Solution Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Solution Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris position at A2G Consulting BV. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience delivering complex platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and system integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am available to start on 16 December 2026 and welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
